lead: Gritty sci-fi film still, worn rusty gunmetal, glowing orange embers.
notes: Mood-only mini images for starforge-legion.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen starforge-legion-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish starforge-legion-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: legion
images.prompt: A small crew of pilots in worn flight suits walking across a dim hangar toward their machines.

images.name: system
images.prompt: A ringed gas giant over a cratered moon, a lone ship crossing in front of it.

images.name: target
images.prompt: The dark silhouette of a man in a long coat standing behind a window in a fortress tower.

images.name: battle
images.prompt: Tracer fire and explosions over a wide cratered plain, a fighter jet streaking low.

images.name: campaign
images.prompt: A row of ten small lights on a worn metal console, the first few glowing orange.

images.name: win-log
images.prompt: A battered logbook lying open on a metal table under a single lamp.

images.name: break
images.prompt: A pilot's helmet resting on a seat in a quiet cockpit, embers of light outside.

images.name: drift
images.prompt: A machine tumbling through empty space with its engines off, stars wheeling behind it.

images.name: weapons
images.prompt: An oversized robot rifle lying in the dust of a battlefield, still smoking.

images.name: worlds
images.prompt: A thin glowing layer of atmosphere over a planet, seen from low orbit, clouds and sea below.
